description.value: Kelowna Cycle, also branded as 'The Hub', is a full-service bicycle retailer in Kelowna carrying road, mountain, gravel, commuter, and electric bikes from brands including Cannondale, Rocky Mountain, Norco, Moustache, and Bianchi. Their in-house service department (Hub Bike Service) handles everything from basic tune-ups to complex repairs. Touring cyclists will find a broad inventory of replacement parts — chains, cables, tires, tubes, derailleurs, and more — alongside a complete accessories selection.
